turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail: ent saidCasper currently ships to all 50 states in the US. For Canadian shipping, you can visit Casper.ca. At this time, Casper does not ship to other international locations.Regarding customs or duties: Since Casper only ships within the US and Canada, any applicable duties or customs fees for Canadian orders would be handled through the Canadian site. For US orders, there are no customs or duties.If you have a specific location in mind or need more details about Canadian shipping, let me know!

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail: ts via UPS typically takes 3–9 business days in transit. Most in-stock products are delivered within 2–8 business days after placing your order, but delivery times can vary by product and size.If you opt for In-Home Delivery and Setup, it usually takes 2–4 weeks.Keep in mind, delivery may take longer during holidays or severe weather.
